svg.title: The Double-Brokering Defense Desk
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-06-fraud-defense-desk; chapter number: 11; title: The Double-Brokering Defense Desk; subtitle: Four controls that treat freight fraud as identity theft; chart type: org_architecture; caption: Double brokering cost an estimated $2 to $3 billion in 2024, and a $75,000 bond paid Convoy carriers under 10 cents on the dollar. Defense is verification, not insurance.; assumptions note: No practitioner reported desk staffing levels, so headcount is left unspecified. Spokes are controls, not mandated roles.; note: Sources - Double Broker Bounty Hunter (J96nZa6x_Ek, 3dI5z6SHDPc, 3WxrmhqpsyY), Highway (b-vDBH9GpuA, sKKld4Wdyqg), Overdrive with Hank Seaton (jnoJihiGSEA) and Freight 360 (uGu6NcZkt28).; center: role: Carrier Vetting and Fraud Desk; headcount: Not reported by practitioners; focus: Confirm who is actually hauling before any pickup number leaves the building.; spokes: role: Association Insights Screen; type: Vetting platform (Highway); kpi: Flag shared addresses, phones and equipment; 10+ trucks claimed from a residential area; 16 trucks with no inspections in 24 months.; role: Rate Anomaly Check; type: Pricing trigger (Double Broker Bounty Hunter); kpi: Dig at 20% above or below market; 30% above is most likely a scam.; role: Credential and PIN Hygiene; type: Account security; kpi: DOT PIN reset since the March 2023 breach; never authenticate a load board login from an emailed link.; role: Pickup Proof and BOL Control; type: Dispatch protocol (Overdrive, Freight 360); kpi: Authorized carrier name on every bill of lading, a gap on two-thirds to three-quarters of shipments; stacked pickup photo requests.
